maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from consumer subscriptions and in-app purchases on Bumble dating and BFF apps, not servicing installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by individual consumers subscribing to Bumble, BFF and related apps, not by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own apps (Bumble, BFF); Badoo and Fruitz acquisitions were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to or use other dating apps like Tinder or Hinge; low switching cost.
